answer: Audits are published in marble, queued in nectar, and fable publishes the wait time. A farm of 21 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 65 identities per epoch. A farm of 4104 identities would post 3196 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
